title: private-agent-mesh-flap-fallback-and-operator-runbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: On 2026-03-08 02:17 UTC a partial outage affected ~18% of private/VPC customer clusters during a staged rollout of orchestrator v2.9.0. Symptoms: control plane gRPC connection spikes, agent reconnect storms, elevated SYN/SYN-ACK churn, and transient outbound connection failures for pods relying on customer NAT gateways. Several customers reported API timeouts and failure to accept traffic from Redwood-managed agents. Root cause hypothesis: an interaction between the agent mesh reconnection behavior and a change in the orchestrator's control plane reconnection handshake introduced in v2.9.0 that removed jitter and relaxed exponential backoff. This produced synchronized reconnection bursts after leader elections and/or brief network hiccups, amplifying ephemeral port usage and overwhelming some NAT gateways and customer firewall tracking tables.

root_cause_summary: An upstream orchestrator change removed randomized jitter from agent reconnection backoff during control plane handshakes. Under normal conditions this is benign, but during leader rebalances and short control-plane flaps it caused a synchronized reconnection storm. High concurrent reconnects drove customer NAT gateways and firewall conntrack tables to exhaustion in multiple VPCs, causing packet drops and long-tail failures for agent-to-control-plane and agent-to-external-services traffic.
impact_details: ~18% of private clusters experienced degraded control plane operations for 20-90 minutes
Multiple customers saw API timeouts and increased request-level 5xxs during the window
Operational cost: on-call rotation and manual rollbacks across 12 clusters; customer-facing incident communications sent
action_items: (A1) Deploy immediate patch to agent v1.14.2 that reintroduces randomized jitter and a capped exponential backoff for reconnects - owner: agent-team - due: 2026-03-18
(A2) Add a circuit-breaker in control plane proxy to rate-limit new session accept attempts per cluster for a 30s warm-up - owner: control-plane-team - due: 2026-03-25
(A3) Create operator runbook 'private-upgrade-network-surge' with step-by-step rollback, NAT exhaustion diagnostics, and live mitigation commands - owner: SRE - due: 2026-03-20
(A4) Implement pre-upgrade 'network stress dry-run' that simulates reconnection bursts in staging to detect conntrack/NAT exhaustion risk - owner: qa/upgrade - due: 2026-04-01
(A5) Instrument eBPF-based conntrack metrics for private clusters and add alert if ephemeral port usage > 70% of provisioned NAT capacity - owner: observability - due: 2026-03-28

(A6) Update private rollout policy to include slower ramp-ups for clusters behind single-provider NATs and require explicit operator approval for batch sizes > 50 - owner: release-engineering - due: 2026-03-22
(A7) Publish a customer advisory with guidance for private VPC configuration (conntrack tuning, NAT autoscaling, firewall timeouts) - owner: solutions - due: 2026-03-26

(A8) Add post-upgrade verification checks (control plane handshake latency, agent reconnect rate, DNS resolution success) run automatically for 15 minutes after upgrade - owner: upgrade-orchestrator - due: 2026-04-05

Circuit-breaker active in staging and prevents >2x baseline new session accepts during flaps
eBPF conntrack alert fires in staging when synthetic load exceeds threshold
Runbook reviewed and signed off by SRE and Support; runbook includes exact commands for rollback and foraging ephemeral port exhaustion metrics
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Rolling back jitter removal reintroduces longer tail recovery for some transient reconnections, potentially increasing latency for rare reconnects. Mitigation: cap maximum backoff and perform conservative rollout with automatic fallback to previous behavior for low-risk clusters. Risk: Customers with restrictive NAT/firewall configurations may still experience edge failures; mitigation: customer advisory and offering a health-check service for large customers to validate conntrack capacity prior to upgrades.
